system.name: Avionics Data Network
system.description: Integrated avionics network with GPS/INS, fly-by-wire control, and cockpit displays.

subsystems.name: Navigation and Guidance Subsystem
subsystems.description: Provides position fixes, inertial reference, and route guidance commands.

subsystems.name: Fly-By-Wire Flight Control Subsystem
subsystems.description: Implements closed-loop flight stability and surface actuation.

subsystems.name: Vehicle Management and Mission Computing Subsystem
subsystems.description: Aggregates avionics status and publishes display products.

subsystems.name: Flight Deck Display Subsystem
subsystems.description: Primary and multifunction displays for pilots.

components.name: GPS Receiver
components.description: Produces position fixes, time, and velocity vectors.

components.name: INS/IMU Unit
components.description: Three gyros and three accelerometers provide inertial reference data.

components.name: Flight Director
components.description: Uses waypoint plans to generate guidance commands.

components.name: Flight Control Computer
components.description: Computes closed-loop control commands for servo actuators.

components.name: Servo Actuator Cluster
components.description: Drives aileron/elevator/rudder surfaces and returns position feedback.

components.name: Vehicle Management Computer
components.description: Combines data from avionics systems and generates display content.

components.name: Primary Flight Display
components.description: Renders synthetic flight symbology and status overlays.

functions.name: Position and Inertial Fusion
functions.description: Fuses gyro and accelerometer measurements into inertial attitude and rates.

functions.name: Waypoint Guidance
functions.description: Computes route-following commands from waypoint plans.

functions.name: Closed-Loop Flight Stability
functions.description: Runs control loops that command servos and consume feedback sensors.

functions.name: Display Composition
functions.description: Builds ARINC 818 video and ancillary data for cockpit displays.

interfaces.name: GPS to Flight Director Position Feed
interfaces.description: Position fixes, UTC, and velocity vectors from GPS receiver to flight director.

interfaces.name: IMU to Flight Control Inertial Feed
interfaces.description: Body rates and accelerations from INS/IMU to FBW control laws.

interfaces.name: Flight Director to FCC Guidance Commands
interfaces.description: Guidance setpoints and waypoint commands published to FBW controller.

interfaces.name: FCC to Servo Actuator Commands
interfaces.description: Discrete fly-by-wire command lines to electro-hydraulic servo actuators.

interfaces.name: Servo Feedback to FCC
interfaces.description: Analog position and rate feedback from control surface actuators.

interfaces.name: Vehicle Management Video to Displays
interfaces.description: Composited flight/degradation symbology and data overlays to cockpit displays.

interfaces.name: FCC Health and States to VMC
interfaces.description: Control law modes, failover status, and servo health reports.
